naming: <species>_<shape>_<anim>; every animation exists in every shape with the same frame size, frame count and fps

furKeys.note: Dog fur 1–2 of the menu ramps; cream muzzle and belly stay fixed. These hexes equal the menu key colors, so the menu recolor shader covers both sheets

sprites.name: Draw pose · dozing off
sprites.note: Nods off where it stands: eyes shut, ears soft, Zs drift up

sprites.name: Draw pose · puzzled
sprites.note: Paw on the chin, head tilts, a question mark bobs: who won?

sprites.name: Aim right · turns the crank by mouth
sprites.note: 40×32, full profile toward the pointer, eyes squeezed, small sweat drops fly off the head in all directions. The head circles 2 px with the handle. Sync with aim_crank 0→7. Place at (50,52) left-hand, flipped at (126,52) right-hand

sprites.name: Aim left · turns the crank by mouth
sprites.note: Sync with aim_crank 0,7,6…1

sprites.name: Aimer idle
sprites.note: Three-quarter view, mouth off the handle. Switch to dog_aim_* the moment a rotate button is held; crank rests on its last frame

sprites.name: Fire · presses the button with the snout
sprites.note: Faces the pointer. Left-hand layout flipped at (124,52), right-hand unflipped at (52,52). fire_button goes down on frame 2

sprites.name: Firer idle
sprites.note: Same spot as dog_press

sprites.name: Fire timer running out · aimer
sprites.note: Same as the aim cycle with wide eyes. Play at double speed

sprites.name: Fire timer running out · firer
sprites.note: Turns face to face with the player and barks in a loop: snout low, rising, up with the mouth wide open and sound ticks, echo ticks on the way down. Front view, never flipped

sprites.name: Knocked out · aimer (launcher)
sprites.note: 40×32, same spot as the aim pose. Bonk · squash, then dog_ko_cower takes over

sprites.name: Knocked out · firer (launcher)
sprites.note: 40×32, same spot as the fire pose. Bonk · squash. Faces right; flip for the left-hand layout

sprites.name: Knocked out · cowering
sprites.note: 40×32 at mechanism (108,92), beside the ring. Rear up, both front paws pressed on the eyes. Rest · flinch, synced with cat_ko_tap. Same for both roles

sprites.name: Knocked by ceiling · as aimer
sprites.note: 48×44. Hit, squash, fall on back, dizzy. Play 0–4, loop 3–4

sprites.name: Knocked by ceiling · as firer
sprites.note: 48×44. Hit, squash, fall sideways, dizzy. Play 0–4, loop 3–4

sprites.name: Expressions
sprites.note: Neutral · Happy · Focused · Surprised · Sad · Panic
